set.body: Acceptance criteria: change build.sbt or sbt-typelevel configuration and regenerate workflows rather than hand-editing generated YAML; ordinary checks contain compile, JVM and Scala.js tests, laws, formatting, docs, MiMa invocation, and boundary checks; dependency submission runs separately with required permissions; publishing runs only for version tags with credentials; a main push is green when code checks pass; hosted evidence records exact run URLs and distinguishes code, security, and release failures.
set.title: Split generated CI into checks, security, and tag release
